event_headline: ₱5 million coordinated online campaign spreads misleading La Union flooding imagery
topic: Integrity of Information and Social Media Manipulation

chronology.action: Allegedly spent approximately ₱5 million on coordinated online campaign using misleading photographs and videos to portray La Union flooding as far worse than reality
Publicly criticized the ₱5 million coordinated online campaign for using misleading flooding imagery

key_actors.name: Ortega
key_actors.role: Official who publicly criticized the campaign
key_actors.stated_position: Condemned the alleged ₱5 million coordinated online campaign for using misleading photographs and videos to misrepresent La Union flooding severity

factual_claims.claim: Approximately ₱5 million was spent on a coordinated online campaign
The campaign used misleading photographs and videos
The imagery portrayed La Union flooding as far worse than reality

verified_facts.claim: Approximately ₱5 million was spent on a coordinated online campaign
verified_facts.finding: The search results contain only dictionary definitions and explanations of the word 'approximately' and its symbol. There is no information about any coordinated online campaign, ₱5 million spending, or any related factual claims that could verify or refute the statement.

verified_facts.claim: The campaign used misleading photographs and videos
verified_facts.finding: The search results contain no information about any campaign using misleading photographs or videos. All results are about a Melbourne-based props and wardrobe rental company called Prop-A-Ganda that services the film, TV, and stage industry. There is no content related to the claim being evaluated.

verified_facts.claim: The imagery portrayed La Union flooding as far worse than reality
verified_facts.finding: The search results contain only general definitions of 'imagery' as a literary device and do not address the specific claim about La Union flooding. None of the sources mention La Union, flooding events, or any comparison between portrayed imagery and reality regarding this location.

disputed_claims.claim: The flooding imagery was deliberately misleading rather than accurate documentation
disputed_claims.competing_accounts: Ortega characterizes it as coordinated misrepresentation to exaggerate severity; no counter-narrative from campaign operators is documented in source material

competing_frames.summary: A well-funded, organized campaign deliberately used false or misleading visual evidence to manipulate public perception of flooding severity for unstated political or economic purposes

competing_frames.frame: Part of broader normalized fake news ecosystem
competing_frames.proponents: Contextual pattern in journals J7, J12, J26
competing_frames.summary: This incident exemplifies an ongoing climate where disinformation peddlers operate unbowed across social media, requiring counter-interventions like fact-checking wraps and pedagogical workbooks
